## Où j'en suis
Real SAML login works on staging with Fernhill’s IdP. JIT provisioning creates users as `viewer`; PR #415 is merged, while PR #421, containing short RelayState and per-tenant group-to-role mapping, is open. The full test suite passed (1,301 passed, 3 skipped). (source: ses-sso-3, kestrel-analytics/platform#415, kestrel-analytics/platform#421)

- [en-cours] Fernhill IT still needs to add the groups claim; until then, the admin mapping cannot be verified end to end. (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] Confirm the groups claim is in place, then test with a Fernhill admin account before Thursday’s 10:00 ET demo. (source: ses-sso-3, src-linear-kes311)
- [essai-raté] The initial SP-initiated login failed because Fernhill’s ADFS rejected the 143-byte RelayState as too long; the fix stores the return URL in Redis and sends a short opaque ID instead. (source: s3-02, s3-04)
- [décision] Keep `viewer` as the default role and leave SP-initiated login enabled; the team will revisit the role with Maya. (source: s3-07)
